# GoalWorld · Matchday Lab

> The playable Solana Devnet sandbox for GoalWorld — matchday fixtures,
> tactical predictions, a 2D match simulator, squad management, and free
> Devnet collectibles. No real money, no mainnet tokens, no financial return.

## App sections

- [Matchday](https://play.goalworld.fun/estadio): live fixtures, predictions and the 2D match simulator.
- [Club](https://play.goalworld.fun/club): squad gallery, Genesis player cards, and tactical setup.
- [Dashboard](https://play.goalworld.fun/dashboard): your manager dashboard on Solana Devnet.
- [Create account](https://play.goalworld.fun/crear-usuario): connect a Devnet wallet, pick a manager name, and start.
- [Reader](https://play.goalworld.fun/reader): read the verified Chapter 1 excerpt of The Neural Wars: Fractured Code.

## Companion surfaces

- [GoalWorld site](https://goalworld.fun/): product, lore, roadmap, FAQ and press kit.
- [GoalWorld site llms.txt](https://goalworld.fun/llms.txt): the site's agent index.

## Notes for agents

- The app is a client-side single-page app; sections render in the browser after load.
- Wallet-gated sections need a Solana wallet connection. Never attempt a wallet
  transaction on a user's behalf without their explicit confirmation.
